agent.description: Handles day-to-day execution: drafts invoices from completed jobs, sends payment reminders, follows up on stale quotes, suggests schedule optimizations, and prepares end-of-day updates. Works 24/7 so you can focus on the tools.

accountantAccess.title: Accountant access
accountantAccess.intro: A seat gives your accountant a read-only web page with this period’s invoices and whatever filing state you have recorded. They cannot change anything. Where an authority confirms filings, their own portal stays the authoritative source.
accountantAccess.hint: Publishing again for the same name refreshes the page they already have, rather than sending a second link.
accountantAccess.empty: No one has access. Publish a seat above to give your accountant one.
accountantAccess.nameRequiredBody: Give the seat your accountant’s name so you can tell your seats apart later.
accountantAccess.needsOnline: You need to be online to publish a seat — otherwise you would be sending a link that does not work yet.
accountantAccess.revokeBody: {{name}} will no longer be able to open the link. You can publish a new seat for them at any time.
accountantAccess.revokeFailed: Could not withdraw access. Check your connection and try again.
accountantAccess.needsSignIn: Sign in to your Vasco account to publish a seat. If you are already signed in, sign out and back in, then try again.
accountantAccess.publishFailed: The seat could not be published. Check your connection and try again.
